messages:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT 3350004321 - alert: sustained spike in external tool/function invocations (toolcall) from multiple tenants. 95th latency to worker pool > 2s, memory OOMs on rtx-2 instances. auto-escalate to #eng-oncall.

jordan (oncall): ack, joining. seeing an increase in fn.invoke.rate and KV cache churn.

alex (eng-sre): on it. dashboard -> https://redwood.internal/obs/alerts/3350004321 shows toolcall QPS ~7x baseline, spike started ~3350004280. Heap pressure + retries.

marina (eng-runtime): likely root cause: newly onboarded agent orchestration (adaptive-toolproxy v2) misbehaving — sending duplicate toolcalls on retry path. I can throttle at the ingress layer but need approval to limit function-calls globally for a short window.

jordan (oncall): recommend immediate mitigation: 1) throttle toolcall path to 10r/s per tenant 2) enforce text-only responses (disable structured output / function routing) 3) notify customers. Agree? :warning:

ben (product): thumbs up to protect latency/SLA. prioritize blocking free-tier/unknown tenants first if possible. We need a customer-impact blurb for comms.

alex (eng-sre): running commands now:
```bash
# soft throttle at edge for toolcall RPCs
redwoodctl traffic-control set-rate --target=toolcall --mode=global --rate=10r/s --duration=30m --reason="surge-3350004321"
# temporary feature flag to force text-only output for affected models
redwoodctl feature-flag set --flag=disable_function_calling --env=prod --value=true --duration=30m
```

ops-bot: applied rate limit: toolcall global rate set to 10r/s (expires 30m). feature flag disable_function_calling=true (expires 30m).

marina (eng-runtime): confirming edge dropped ~75% of toolcall traffic. worker OOMs are stabilizing, CPU back to normal. latency 95th down to 450ms. Good short-term relief.

jordan (oncall): customer impact summary for comms: "Some customers may see functions/tools disabled and structured outputs suppressed for up to 30 minutes while we remediate an unexpected invocation storm. This protects overall latency and availability."

ben (product): copy for status page draft. Add note: we will follow up with tenant-level details if impacted.

alex (eng-sre): next steps: 1) roll back adaptive-toolproxy v2 for affected region 2) run per-tenant audit to identify origin of duplicate calls 3) increase circuit-breaker sensitivity on retries. I'll start the rollback now.

marina (eng-runtime): rollback command queued: `deployctl rollback adaptive-toolproxy v1.9 --region=us-east-1` — will trigger rolling restart of 8 pods, expect 7m to converge.

jordan (oncall): fine. handing off monitoring and next actions to @sudha in 10m. sudha, please take post-mitigation watch and coordinate follow-up ops.

sudha (next-oncall): ack, will pick up. please leave runbook pointers.

alex (eng-sre): runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/toolcall-surge — key checklists included. Also creating a Jira: RW-INC-3350004321 to track RCA and tenant comms.

ops-bot: Jira issue RW-INC-3350004321 created and assigned to eng-sre.

marina (eng-runtime): note for RCA: add logging to label request path with agent-id and dedupe token to catch duplicate retries. I'll drop a PR for quick instrumentation.

jordan (oncall): summary/close plan: continue 30m watch, if stable extend feature-flag to 2h while we validate rollback. prep customer emails for affected tenants after we identify them. If errors resurge, escalate to infra lead.

ben (product): schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 11:00. include SRE, runtime, product, support.

ops-bot: Mitigation window ends at 3350006121 unless extended.

sudha (next-oncall): taking over watch. ping me if anything changes.

jordan (oncall): thanks team. closing direct paging for now — will re-open if metrics deviate. :white_check_mark:
